ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (>80%) with localized low-intensity black regions (<20%) primarily along the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. Thick black pigment bordering the entire trailing edge. A vertical black streak originates from the median notch, connecting to an irregular black cluster at the lower center. Isolated dark pixels and small clusters scattered across the lateral surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with steep inward-sloping walls.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Multiple high-amplitude peaks and jagged valleys observed, particularly dense towards the outer fluke tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outer margins curving upwards and outwards from the water line towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular dark pigment spots on the inner right lobe and along the lower margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, dark linear pixel streaks observed horizontally on the lower left lobe and diagonally on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A complex, irregular black pigmentation pattern extending from the median notch downward, terminating in a large, jagged splotch near the visible waterline.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy dark pigmentation at the extreme lateral tips of the flukes, contrasting sharply with the white interior.
